energy_unit: eV per 12-atom Hf4O8 cell; 4 formula units
selection: all eight nonzero points of the central {-0.05,0,0.05} A square; no energy selection
branch_start_policy: nearest central training point by exact integer Q distance; ties original ID; one safe start; never use test labels

scoring.primary: seen-origin-aligned signed error, max absolute error and RMSE; all five arms
scoring.secondary: uncalibrated signed errors and origin biases, never discard either step
scoring.cohort: same valid candidate labels for all arms; also report per-arm abstention and missing/failed labels out of eight

test_execution_policy.initial_hessian: original step 0.01 symmetrized full internal Hessian
test_execution_policy.prerequisites: complete native B3 and released-Q0 curvature audits; both raw R34 steps positive as necessary local evidence, not global certification; final candidate predictions locked before labels
